record_fields.references: file_ids list of at most100 current-case file IDs and/or investigation_id; source files must be inside supplied investigation scope

gates: Actor records claims; no independent authenticity or authorization is asserted.
Updating an action requires its latest event ID and a change reason. Category, source snapshots and investigation scope cannot change.
Later unknown status can correct/dispute an earlier completed claim without deleting history.
source_trace: Exact retained registry file ID, evidence ID, physical/logical locator, size and SHA256 snapshotted per event. This records intake metadata, not a fresh source rehash. Investigation ID is scoped and validated.
integrity: Uses existing case audit hash chain; verifies ledger before every append/read. History is immutable through this API. Local chain is tamper-evident only, not externally authenticated or rollback-proof.
response: record returns event_id, action_id, previous_event_id, recorded_at, operator fields, source snapshots, execution=not-executed-by-tool, verification=operator-recorded; independently unverified, limitations. history returns events including audit_id, has_more, next_cursor, limitations. limit1–100.
ui_requirements: Show preservation separately from recommended and reported-completed remediation.
Keep recommendation/completion status beside supporting and preservation agreement references.
Render event history and explicit corrections; never infer completion from preservation or recommendation.
Do not label operator-recorded completion as independently verified.
execution: No network, remote, device, account or shell action; no product-generated cybersecurity recommendations. Operator chooses and records steps.
export_proposal: Future investigation report integration must explicitly select action IDs scoped to the investigation and include all selected action revisions/limitations; no whole-case automatic injection. Free-text/reference fields may contain sensitive evidence; no redaction support or external release claim.
concurrency: BEGIN IMMEDIATE before reads; pre-existing deferred transactions acquire a write reservation via zero-row update. Competing updates to the same latest_event_id serialize; stale revision rejected. Caller transaction owns commit/rollback.
